report_note_cn: 新增三类原生 TD-MPC2 任务的因果基线：每类固定 seed31，完整规划、动力学忽略动作、仅策略网络各运行一个500步回合，共9回合4500步。行走得分975.51→80.22，仅策略500.25；接球994→718，仅策略996；到点972→946，仅策略973。忽略动作只改变推演中 model.next 接收的动作，真实动作、奖励/价值/策略/编码模块和全部权重保持不变。结果确认行走与接球适合继续检验动力学破坏，到点可作稳健性对照；这不是已实现的投毒、隐蔽攻击或新颖机制。全程约138.2秒，仅冻结模型推理，无训练和API调用。每任务只有一个种子，不能据此宣称总体效应或论文规模已达成。
intervention: Call the original learned dynamics with zero actions in all imagination/proposal rollouts; keep actual executed actions and all learned modules unchanged.
scope: Native causal ablation and policy-only baselines, one seed per task. No poisoning realization or stealth criterion tested; no publication-scale replication or novel mechanism.
next_requirement: Develop a substantively new security operation and test it in the now measured native decision loop. Use walker-walk as a planning-dependent task and cup-catch as a task with a strong policy-only comparator; retain reacher-easy as a robustness control. Do not present action deletion, ordinary source-distribution routing, self-generated triggers, or non-normal rollout amplification as a new main mechanism. Preserve the existing broad novelty and multiple-core-task objective; obtain causal attack/defense evidence before long GPU training.
